texts.qa_answer_1: We run the XRay 26.7.28+ core with the XHTTP transport and the REALITY plugin. Protocols are VLESS and Shadowsocks. On top of that we apply ML-KEM-768 post-quantum encryption, xPadding obfuscation and xmux multiplexing. This is one of the most modern and fastest stacks available today, not an outdated WireGuard or OpenVPN setup.
texts.qa_answer_2: Yes, the no-logs policy is strictly enforced. Servers do not store browsing history, traffic content, user IP addresses or activity timestamps. Only the minimal technical details of your subscription are kept — plan, expiry and remaining traffic — which are required to run the service and reveal nothing about what you do online.
texts.qa_answer_3: Layered encryption: TLS 1.3, XTLS Vision and REALITY, plus ML-KEM-768 post-quantum encryption for extra protection against a future break of mathematical algorithms.
texts.qa_answer_4: No. REALITY makes VPN traffic indistinguishable from ordinary web browsing: to a packet analysis system it looks like a connection to a legitimate site and uses a real website certificate. This is not hidden traffic with telltale patterns, unlike most VPNs.
texts.qa_answer_5: All traffic is encrypted with modern protocols, and the connection to our central server in Switzerland is additionally protected. Intercepting or reading your data by third parties is technically impossible: even if traffic were captured, it would only be an encrypted stream with integrity checks.
texts.qa_answer_6: Because the service keeps no logs and collects no traffic data, there is technically nothing to hand over. Our central server is located in Switzerland, a jurisdiction with one of the strongest privacy protections in the world, where the law does not force operators to disclose data to foreign governments without a decision of a Swiss court.
texts.qa_answer_7: The central server and all management infrastructure are located in Switzerland. This is deliberate: Swiss law is known for some of the strictest privacy and banking secrecy norms in the world. The country is not part of intelligence-sharing alliances, which means real privacy rather than a declarative one that can be revoked by a single request from another jurisdiction.
texts.qa_answer_8: The project was founded by two enthusiasts. The technical administrator has extensive experience in network infrastructure. We are not a corporation and we do not monetize your data: we build the VPN we use ourselves and keep prices below the market.
texts.qa_answer_9: This is a long-term project. We care about stable operation and constant improvement: we expand the server network, update the core and build our own client. We intend to develop the service for years rather than shutting it down after a season.
texts.qa_answer_10: We keep no logs, which means there is simply no data about you that could be taken or sold. You can always reach us directly via Telegram. A small scale means more attention per user: support replies fast and issues are handled manually.
texts.qa_answer_11: We are among the best in the industry by the combination of factors, not by a single one. First, Swiss jurisdiction and strict no-logs. Second, a modern XRay + REALITY stack with ML-KEM-768 post-quantum encryption — most competitors have not reached this yet. Third, our own infrastructure in Switzerland and full control over the servers. And fourth, we are already building our own VPN client that competitors do not have, and we are genuinely the best in our niche for quality, price and support.
texts.qa_answer_12: We are working on our own VPN client: one clean interface, automatic selection of the best server, fast config switching, built-in connection checks and no unnecessary settings. In parallel we expand the network, update the XRay core and add new locations and plans. We improve the service regularly and do not abandon it after the sales.
texts.qa_answer_13: Low cost means no marketing spend, no office overhead, no middlemen and no advertising budgets. Everything you pay goes into servers and connection quality, not into customer acquisition. We do not run an aggressive ad model and we never resell your data.
texts.qa_answer_14: A plan includes access to the VPN servers, VPN links, support and traffic statistics. The price depends on traffic volume, number of devices, subscription period and the locations you choose. Renewals of an active plan get special conditions, and trust points automatically reduce the final price.
texts.qa_answer_15: Yes, traffic is limited within your plan. The usage is visible in your profile, on the website and in the bot, and a normalizer reconciles it daily. When the limit is reached, speed is restricted until the next package or renewal. The limits keep resources used sensibly and are enough for the vast majority of users.
texts.qa_answer_16: A custom plan is one you build yourself: you set the traffic volume, number of devices, period and the locations you need, and the price is calculated automatically. It is convenient when the ready-made plans do not fit your use case.
texts.qa_answer_17: Usually 50-100 Mbit/s on a single device, and higher during peak hours on fast lines. The exact speed depends on your ISP, as some operators throttle VPN traffic. Modern protocols, the XHTTP transport and BBR congestion control minimize this effect.
texts.qa_answer_18: It depends on: your ISP plan, the ISP practice of throttling VPN traffic, client settings, channel load and distance to the server. The Swiss servers sit close to the key European routes, so the path is short and load is spread across several points.
texts.qa_answer_19: Thanks to the compact geography and several entry points, the ping from most European cities is usually 15-45 ms. The exact value depends on your ISP route and region. Server status is shown in your account so you can immediately pick the nearest available point.
texts.qa_answer_20: Yes. The protocols and transport are designed for large data transfers without loss, so high-quality streaming, gaming and large file downloads all work. xmux multiplexing uses the connection efficiently with several simultaneous sessions, and stability is ensured by failover between points.
texts.qa_answer_21: All current clients are supported: V2RayNG and Hiddify for Android, Streisand and V2Box for iOS, V2RayN for Windows, V2RayU for macOS, Nekoray and Hiddify for Linux, plus clients for Android TV and routers. Any client that speaks VLESS and Shadowsocks will work.
texts.qa_answer_22: A subscription gives you ready-made VPN links in the My Subscription section of the bot and in your account on the website. These are ordinary vless:// and ss:// links that you import into any supported client with one tap — there is no configuration file to set up manually.
texts.qa_answer_23: The number of simultaneously connected devices is set by the plan. In a custom plan you can choose this number yourself while calculating the price.
texts.qa_answer_24: Yes. You can add the link to a router client and share Wi-Fi across the whole home, and to Android TV to watch video on the television. No special router setup is needed: import the link into its VPN client exactly as you do on a phone.
texts.qa_answer_25: The general steps are: pick a link in the My Subscription section, install the right client for your platform, open the link from the bot or copy it from your account and import it into the client, then hit connect. The Setup Guide section has step-by-step instructions and ready configs for every device.
texts.qa_answer_26: Our own client is already in development and will be available to subscribers. It picks the best server automatically, switches configs fast, shows the connection state and needs no manual parameter tuning. Watch for updates in the bot, the release will be announced officially.
texts.qa_answer_27: Trust points are a loyalty program. Every subscription or plan payment earns you 5% of the amount, up to 100 points per single purchase. Points accumulate automatically, and the exact count and the discount size are visible in your profile on the website and in the bot. The higher your trust, the bigger the final discount.
texts.qa_answer_28: The discount is applied automatically: the higher your trust points, the larger the discount percentage, which applies to all plans — both ready-made and custom. There is nothing to activate, and the current discount is visible before payment and in your profile.
texts.qa_answer_29: Every user has a personal referral link. A user invited through it gets a welcome bonus right away: trust points are credited instantly, while bonus subscription days are credited after the first plan payment. For a paying invitee you receive bonus days yourself, and partners additionally earn a commission on every payment through their link.
texts.qa_answer_30: Two methods are available: a fast payment via YuMoney and a bank card transfer (P2P). After transferring, send the receipt to support, which speeds things up. Payments are confirmed manually, and once confirmed the subscription is activated automatically and you receive ready VPN links.
texts.qa_answer_31: Through the Telegram bot or the contact form in your account on the website. Support replies directly, without ticket systems and bots, usually within an hour, and faster on payment questions if you attach the receipt.
texts.qa_answer_32: Check the subscription status and expiry in your account or the bot, then try a different endpoint and make sure the current config is selected in your client. If nothing helps, write to support with your UID and a description of the problem and we will sort it out manually and issue a working link.
texts.qa_answer_33: The bot is the main control panel for your subscription. From the main menu you buy or renew a plan, check the status and VPN links in the My Subscription section, set up client apps, use the referral system and apply for the partner program. Both fixed and custom plans with automatic calculation are available, in several interface languages.
texts.qa_answer_34: The website is a web interface for the subscription and the personal account. The home page shows service statistics and server status. In the Subscription section you pick a plan, including a custom one with a dynamic price calculation, and pay for it. Your account provides the subscription status, traffic with a progress bar, trust points, VPN links and client setup for all platforms. In settings you can change the language, theme, password and Telegram link.
texts.qa_answer_35: A subscription can be cancelled at any time, but it stays active until the end of the paid period; the unused period is not refunded, as stated in the offer. A refund is considered case by case if the service was not delivered through our fault: just write to support and we will handle it like humans.

sections.content: This policy describes what technical data {vpnName} processes when operating the website, bot, and VPN service. By using the service, you agree to this policy.
sections.title: Privacy Policy of {vpnName} VPN Service

sections.content:
1.1. {vpnName} respects user privacy and ensures the protection of personal data.
1.2. This policy is developed in accordance with the principles of data minimisation.
1.3. We collect only the data necessary for the functioning of the service.
sections.title: 1. General Provisions

sections.content:
2.1. The service may process:
- User's Telegram ID and username
- Selected tariff and technical subscription status
- Payment data (only for payment confirmation, not stored)
- Technical connection information

2.2. We do NOT collect:
- Passport data
- Phone numbers (except as specified in the partnership section)
- Email addresses (except as specified in the payment section)
- Other information not listed in clause 2.1
sections.title: 2. What Data Is Processed

sections.content:
3.1. {vpnName} adheres to a strict No‑Logs policy:
- No history of visited websites is kept
- No analysis of traffic content
- No connection logs are saved
- No user activity is tracked

3.2. For subscription operation, only aggregated metrics may be processed:
- Total traffic used
- Subscription validity period
- Connection status (active/inactive)
sections.title: 3. No‑Logs Policy

sections.content:
4.1. Collected data is used solely for:
- User registration and authentication
- Issuing and managing VPN subscriptions
- Technical support for users
- Preventing abuse and fraud
- Processing payment transactions
- Notifying about maintenance and service changes

- Active subscriptions: for the entire term
- Inactive subscriptions: up to 3 days after expiration
- Payment data: not stored, used only for confirmation

5.2. After the retention period, data is automatically deleted.

- Data encryption during transmission (TLS/SSL)
- Secure storage in databases
- Restricted access to data
